story: As an organizer, I want to use Event Creation & Management so that I can achieve its intended outcome
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Create, edit, and publish event pages in under 10 minutes
System supports: Configure ticket types (free, paid, tiered) with capacity limits
System supports: Manage waitlists and set refund policies
System supports: Customize registration forms
System supports: Duplicate events
System supports: Export attendee lists

story: As an attendee, I want to receive and access my ticket easily so that I can attend the event without confusion or delay
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Generate QR-based digital tickets
System supports: Email ticket delivery with 99% SLA
System supports: Mobile-friendly ticket access
System supports: Real-time check-in via QR scanning or manual entry
System supports: Track attendance in real-time

story: As an organizer, I want payments and payouts to be processed reliably so that I can collect revenue and understand when funds will be released
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Stripe Connect integration for payment acceptance
System supports: Apply 3% platform fee on ticket sales
System supports: Process weekly bank transfers (ACH/SEPA/local equivalents)
System supports: Hold payouts for 14 days post-event for chargeback windows
System supports: Enforce minimum payout threshold with rollover to next cycle
System supports: Withhold payouts if organizer has open disputes or fraud flags
Organizer can view payout status (pending, held, released) for each transaction
System prevents payouts if organizer account has unresolved disputes or fraud flags
System displays expected payout release date based on hold rules

story: As an user, I want to use Refund Processing & Dispute Resolution so that I can achieve its intended outcome
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Block refund requests after event check-in based on attendance records
System supports: Process refunds within 5-7 business days
System supports: Flag and block duplicate refund requests
System supports: Trigger manual review for refunds requested within 24 hours of event
System supports: Allow admin override of organizer decisions in dispute escalation
System supports: Log fraud patterns for risk scoring

story: As an organizer, I want to use Event Discovery & Search so that I can achieve its intended outcome
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Public event listings with featured events section
System supports: Search and filter by category, date, and location
System supports: Sort results by date and popularity
System supports: Generate shareable event links
System supports: Support up to 10,000 attendees per event

story: As an organizer, I want to use Organizer Verification & Onboarding so that I can achieve its intended outcome
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Verify identity via government ID
System supports: Verify business registration documents
System supports: Validate payment methods
System supports: Perform risk scoring and approval workflow
System supports: Assign status: Pending, Approved, Suspended, or Rejected

story: As an organizer, I want to use Event Moderation & Content Policy so that I can achieve its intended outcome
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Automatically flag prohibited categories (illegal activities, hate speech, deceptive events, high-risk financial products)
System supports: Manually review flagged events within 24 hours
System supports: Notify organizers of removal with reason
System supports: Provide organizer appeal process with 5 business day response
System supports: Enforce escalating actions: warning, event removal, account suspension

story: As an organizer, I want to use Organizer Suspension & Account Recovery so that I can achieve its intended outcome
acceptance_criteria: System supports: Implement temporary (30-day) and permanent suspension types
System supports: Require violation acknowledgment and policy compliance for reinstatement
System supports: Provide appeal process within 14 days with 5 business day admin review
System supports: Maintain read-only access to historical data during suspension
System supports: Process payouts for pre-suspension events normally
